description: Source code for an HTML report generator and reporter for Playwright test results, including classes for building and serving HTML reports, handling test data, and integrating with Playwright's test framework.

classes.name: HtmlReporter
classes.description: Implements the ReporterV2 interface to generate HTML reports for Playwright test results, handle report configuration, and serve reports via HTTP.

classes.name: HtmlBuilder
classes.description: Builds the HTML report, serializes test data, copies assets, and generates the final report files.

classes.name: Base64Encoder
classes.description: A stream transform that encodes data to Base64, used for embedding zip data into HTML.

methods.name: reportFolderFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves the report output folder path from environment variables.

methods.name: getHtmlReportOptionProcessEnv
methods.description: Gets the HTML report open option from environment variables, validating its value.

methods.name: standaloneDefaultFolder
methods.description: Returns the default folder for reports, based on environment or default path.

methods.name: showHTMLReport
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server to serve the HTML report and optionally opens it in a browser.

methods.name: startHtmlReportServer
methods.description: Creates and configures an HTTP server to serve report files.
